plugin.name: Super Workspace Lock

settings.title: Super Workspace Lock — Settings
settings.ownRemoved: Removed: the system password opens it

settings.ownHas: Own password set (the system password also opens it)
card.private.desc: Covered with a heavy blur and locked when you leave it.
card.lockMode.desc: Right away, or after some time away from it.
card.delay.desc: How long it stays open after you leave it.
card.password.desc: The system password always opens it, even with its own password.
card.shortcut.desc: Locks the workspace you are on (a public one stays public after you unlock it).
card.allowed.desc: Only these work while the blur is up. Red ones are not in Omarchy's keybindings and do nothing.
card.generalLock.desc: For every workspace left on Default.
general.intro: Defaults for every workspace. Each workspace can override them in the Workspaces tab.
